messages:
ryan (new-hire): Hey folks, ryan here. First on-call rotation is Friday night. Quick sanity check: do I need any extra Confluence perms beyond SSO to view runbook attachments? Also my OpsGenie test page didn't hit my phone.
lee (oncall-lead): Welcome! Attachments are restricted via the runbook ACL. If you can view the page but not the attachments it's an ACL issue 1. Say your SSO and @ada will fix. For OpsGenie, make sure Push is enabled and your timezone in profile is correct.
ada (sre): I added ryan@redwood.com to runbook-attachments. Try refresh. Also re-sent OpsGenie invite. If push still fails, check mobile background refresh and confirm device listed in OpsGenie profile.
ryan (new-hire): I can see attachments now, thanks. OpsGenie push shows but test ack times out with "device unreachable".
ada (sre): Two quick checks: 1) Open OpsGenie app and sign out/in 2) In the app Settings -> Notifications, ensure Allow Notifications is ON. Sometimes corporate MDM blocks background delivery until device is approved.
devx-bot: Reminder: On-call shadow pairing and mock incident drill scheduled Sat 18:00 PT. RSVP in the calendar note.
ryan (new-hire): Signed up for the mock. One more oddball: when I run `kubectl get pods -n model-serving` I see my laptop IP blocked by envoy. Any hints?
ada (sre): Likely your laptop isn't in the internal CIDR yet. Check `ip a` and `sudo ip route`. If you don't have the 10.0.0.0/8 route, tailscale didn't provision correctly. If tailscale shows connected but no route, re-run tailscale up and re-auth.
ryan (new-hire): Re-auth fixed routing, pods list works. Appreciate the quick help.
lee (oncall-lead): A few onboarding rules: 1) First two shifts are shadowed 1, don't page execs solo. 2) Use the incident template verbatim for any customer-impacting incident. 3) If alerts flood, pause noise using the runbook's "silence noisy alerts" command.
ryan (new-hire): Got it. Small request: can I swap my Sun night shadow to Mon? I have a personal conflict.
lee (oncall-lead): We can swap if someone covers. Post availability in #eng-oncall-swap and I'll approve once someone volunteers. Try to give 24h notice.
pagerbot: Scheduled: Ryan shadow with Lee 1 2026-05-03 01:00-09:00 UTC. Good luck! :rocket:
